design.summary: Header order does not allow the helper next to the owner: the owner is the plugin launch loop [h/tron/plugins/llama.hpp:606-611] plus Note [Attention workers are the last pool workers] [h/tron/models/model.hpp:2253-2275], and the include chain is attn_stats.hpp (self_attention.hpp:27) -> self_attention.hpp (model.hpp) -> model.hpp (llama.hpp:26). The owner-adjacent alternative is the pool itself: a free function in h/tron/threading.hpp near app_pool() or a static on thread_pool.
